title: 8.70. Pariyāpannaduka
note: Pāli only: every English translation of the Abhidhamma is still under copyright, so no English can be shown yet. A free translation will be added if one becomes available.

verses.t: Napariyāpannaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca napariyāpanno dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā … tīṇi.
Naapariyāpannaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca naapariyāpanno dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā … ekaṁ.
Napariyāpannañca naapariyāpannañca dhammaṁ paṭicca naapariyāpanno dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā … ekaṁ. (Saṅkhittaṁ.)
Hetuyā pañca, ārammaṇe dve …pe… avigate pañca.
